description.value: Hiel Cafe is a ground-floor cafe in a commercial building on 6th Street in Burnaby, offering indoor seating in a no-smoking environment. It operates as a neighbourhood cafe with a social-media presence on Instagram, suggesting a community-oriented character. Touring cyclists passing through the area would find it a potential rest stop, though details about the menu and facilities are not publicly verifiable.
